items.title: Sandisk and More Chip Stocks Hit China Roadblocks
items.summary: FEATURE  China threw up a couple of roadblocks for chips stocks Monday, forcing Sandisk ASML Holding and a host of others into the ditch. The obstacles: a massive Chinese IPO and a state-backed company’s mass production of chip-making machines.

items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, Workday, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  A chip stock slide weighed on the major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines. Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: CXMT’s Blockbuster IPO Hits MU, SNDK and WDC—Is the Memory Rally at Risk?
items.summary: Memory and storage stocks came under pressure on July 27 after China’s leading semiconductor manufacturer, ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), delivered a blockbuster Shanghai stock market debut to surpass a $500 billion valuation. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) shares fell 5%, Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) declined around 12%, while Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) also traded sharply lower on […]

items.title: Seagate, Western Digital Slide Again. Morgan Stanley Still 'Pounding The Table' For Both AI Stocks.
items.summary: Seagate Technology and Western Digital each saw their stock reverse sharply lower Monday, continuing a pullback for the hard-disk-drive makers.  Seagate will report fiscal fourth-quarter earnings late Tuesday.  Morgan Stanley analyst Erik Woodring told clients Monday that the market for hard-disk drives has only grown stronger.

items.title: Is Silicon Motion Stock a Strong Buy Before Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: SIMO is set to report Q2 earnings with rising estimates, a modest surprise track record and growing enterprise and embedded storage momentum.

items.title: SanDisk Sinks 12%, Micron Drops 5%, SK Hynix Falls 8% as China’s CXMT IPO Rattles Memory Stocks
items.summary: China's CXMT just pulled off one of the most explosive stock market debuts in history, and memory giants with triple-digit gains on the books are now facing a sector-wide reckoning that could upend the entire bull case for DRAM and NAND.
